gen-amatic-sc-gf-vend-sans: Rustic and quirky: Amatic SC wanders casually across the line while Vend Sans stays ruler-straight, with curves left generously unclosed. Vend Sans can run modestly small and still fill the line.
gen-audiowide-gf-cambo: Futuristic tiles meet bookish ink, Audiowide leading and Cambo following. Audiowide keeps its strokes uniform around every curve, while Cambo adds a mild, approachable stroke contrast that relaxes each word.
gen-audiowide-gf-manuale: Marker-traced tech: Audiowide stacks its tall lowercase like tiles, with grout-wide gaps between glyphs. Then Manuale, large-eyed and softly contrasted, settles into paragraphs with a warm, unhurried rhythm.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-serif-armenian: Futuristic from the first glyph, Audiowide keeps its strokes uniform, while Noto Serif Armenian opens big counters in every small letter. Its standout quality is tech polish set against old-world authority.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-serif-bengali: Pipe-cleaner joins meet spring-wire contrast: Audiowide above Noto Serif Bengali. Noto Serif Bengali, with trimmed ascenders in a thick band of letters, holds up well at a modest size.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-serif-dives-akuru: Matched horizontals and verticals give Audiowide a built-from-tiles look up top. Noto Serif Dives Akuru then reads like old letterpress, its soft curves and short capitals among tall small letters carrying paragraphs gently.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-serif-georgian: Constant pen pressure up top: Audiowide, with Noto Serif Georgian below. Audiowide does futuristic display best, while Noto Serif Georgian's swollen lowercase and subdued contrast are made for steady text.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-serif-gurmukhi: Audiowide has no hairlines anywhere, just tall lowercase and tile-like glyphs built to catch the eye. But Noto Serif Gurmukhi does the quieter work, its gradual weight change and modest contrast rewarding a close look.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-serif-khmer: Tile-like glyphs with no stroke contrast: Audiowide sets the pace. Noto Serif Khmer follows with modest hairline thinning and lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals, a slower place for the eye.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-serif-khojki: Noto Serif Khojki keeps its ascenders short above big bowls, with mild stress in the o. And Audiowide, with its rounded-wire strokes and tile-like glyphs, gives that quiet text a futuristic lead.
